user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use on bilkatogo.dk.

data_description.email: The email address of your BilkaToGo account.
data_description.password: The password of your BilkaToGo account.

reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} no longer works. Enter the password you use on bilkatogo.dk now.

data_description.password: The password of your BilkaToGo account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Bilka. Try again later.
error.unknown: Bilka answered unexpectedly. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This BilkaToGo account is already added.

update_failed.message: Could not fetch orders from Bilka: {error}

entry_not_found.message: No BilkaToGo account has the entry ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The BilkaToGo account {title} is not loaded.

entry_required.message: More than one BilkaToGo account is added. Choose which one to use.

cart_change_rejected.message: Bilka did not change the cart: {error}

no_pickup_point.message: Your cart has no pickup point or home delivery address. Choose one with the Choose pickup point action or on bilkatogo.dk first.

action_failed.message: Bilka could not complete the action: {error}

no_items_added.message: Bilka added none of the products: {error}

pickup_slot_sold_out.message: The pickup slot {slot} is sold out. Your cart keeps its slot.

pickup_slot_closed.message: The pickup slot {slot} is closed. Your cart keeps its slot.

pickup_slot_unavailable.message: The pickup slot {slot} cannot be chosen: {error}. Your cart keeps its slot.

pickup_slot_not_offered.message: Bilka offers no pickup slot on {date} starting at {start} for your cart.

pickup_slot_ambiguous.message: Several pickup slots on {date} start at {start}. Give the end time too.

unknown_pickup_point.message: Bilka has no pickup point named {pickup_point} for your cart. Your cart stays where it is.

no_home_address.message: Your home address for home delivery is not known yet. Choose home delivery once on bilkatogo.dk, then try again.

add_to_cart.name: Add to cart
add_to_cart.description: Adds a product to your BilkaToGo cart, on top of what is already there.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The BilkaToGo account to use. Only needed when more than one is added.

article_number.name: Article number
article_number.description: Bilka's article number of the product, as the search action returns it.

add_items_to_cart.name: Add items to cart
add_items_to_cart.description: Adds several products to your BilkaToGo cart, one after another, on top of what is already there. Products Bilka rejects are listed in the response; the action fails only when none could be added.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The BilkaToGo account to use. Only needed when more than one is added.

items.name: Items
items.description: A list of products, each with article_number and an optional quantity (default 1).

remove_from_cart.name: Remove from cart
remove_from_cart.description: Removes a product, or some of it, from your BilkaToGo cart.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The BilkaToGo account to use. Only needed when more than one is added.

article_number.name: Article number
article_number.description: Bilka's article number of the product, as the search action returns it.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How many to remove. Leave it out to remove the product entirely.

search.name: Search products
search.description: Searches products at the store serving your cart's pickup point, with price, stock and offers.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The BilkaToGo account to use. Only needed when more than one is added.

query.name: Query
query.description: What to search for, e.g. skyr.

in_stock.name: In stock
in_stock.description: Only products in stock at the store.

on_offer.name: On offer
on_offer.description: Only products with an offer or a multibuy offer at the store.

in_leaflet.name: In the leaflet
in_leaflet.description: Only products in this week's Bilka leaflet.

sort.name: Sort
sort.description: Orders the best matches, up to the limit, by price or unit price, counting offers.

get_cart.name: Get cart
get_cart.description: Returns what is in your BilkaToGo cart, with its total, without changing it.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The BilkaToGo account to use. Only needed when more than one is added.

choose_pickup_slot.name: Choose pickup slot
choose_pickup_slot.description: Chooses an open pickup slot for your BilkaToGo cart and returns it with the slot it replaced. It holds nothing: the slot can still sell out until you order on bilkatogo.dk.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The BilkaToGo account to use. Only needed when more than one is added.

date.name: Date
date.description: The date of the pickup slot. For a home delivery night slot, the date Bilka lists it on.

end.name: End
end.description: When the pickup slot ends. Only needed when two slots start at the same time.

choose_pickup_point.name: Choose pickup point
choose_pickup_point.description: Moves your BilkaToGo cart to another pickup point and returns what that changed: the store, total and fees, products the store can't supply, and whether your pickup slot is still open.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The BilkaToGo account to use. Only needed when more than one is added.

pickup_point.name: Pickup point
pickup_point.description: The pickup point's name, as bilkatogo.dk shows it, e.g. Bilka Odense.

choose_home_delivery.name: Choose home delivery
choose_home_delivery.description: Moves your BilkaToGo cart to home delivery at your home address and returns what that changed, with the delivery fee and minimum order. Choose home delivery once on bilkatogo.dk first, so that your home address is known.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The BilkaToGo account to use. Only needed when more than one is added.
